_doc: Curation register — the human gate of the pipeline. An external recipe is imported ONLY if it has an entry here: canonical id, minimum age, functional roles, and steps rewritten in our own words. No entry, no import.

partenaire-qc:creamy-shrimp-and-pea-riso.name: Creamy shrimp and pea risotto
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in the oil until translucent.
Add the rice and stir for 1 minute, then add the broth one ladle at a time, stirring.
In the last 5 minutes, add the peas and the shrimp.
Remove from the heat and stir in the parmesan.

partenaire-qc:soft-apricot-granola.name: Soft apricot granola
steps: Mix the oats, flaxseed and cinnamon.
Pour in the maple syrup and oil, then coat well.
Spread on a baking sheet and bake at 150 °C for 20 minutes, stirring halfway.
Fold in the apricots once cooled.

partenaire-qc:mild-chicken-quesadillas.name: Mild chicken quesadillas
steps: Spread the chicken, cheese and bell pepper over half of each tortilla.
Fold over and brown in a pan, 2 to 3 minutes per side.
Let cool slightly, then cut into narrow wedges.

partenaire-qc:tomato-alphabet-soup.name: Tomato alphabet soup
steps: Soften the onion and carrot in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, broth and basil, then bring to a boil.
Add the pasta and cook according to the package.
Mash a few vegetables with a fork to thicken.

partenaire-qc:crispy-tofu-with-sweet-map.name: Crispy tofu with sweet maple sauce
steps: Pat the tofu dry and cube it, then coat in cornstarch.
Brown the cubes in the oil on all sides.
Mix the soy sauce, syrup, garlic and ginger, pour over and let it coat for 1 minute.

partenaire-qc:carrot-and-maple-muffins.name: Carrot and maple muffins
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C.
Mix the eggs, applesauce, oil and syrup.
Fold in the flour, baking powder and cinnamon, then the carrots.
Bake in muffin cups for 18 to 20 minutes.

spoonacular-demo:101.name: Creamy salmon pasta
steps: Cook the pasta according to the package.
Sear the salmon in the oil, then flake it with a fork.
Warm the cream with the garlic, then toss with the pasta, salmon and parmesan.
Cut the pasta short for the youngest children.

spoonacular-demo:102.name: Banana oat pancakes
steps: Blend all the ingredients until smooth.
Cook small pancakes over medium heat, 2 minutes per side.
Serve in finger-width strips.

spoonacular-demo:103.name: Vegetable fried rice
steps: Scramble the eggs in the oil, then set aside.
Stir-fry the carrot and peas for 3 minutes.
Add the rice and soy sauce, return the eggs and heat through.

mealdb-demo:52850.name: Chicken couscous
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in the oil.
Add the diced chicken and brown it.
Pour in the broth, add the carrot and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the couscous, cover and let it swell for 5 minutes.
